description: SMARTS filters include the standard Johnson-Cousins optical filter sets deployed on SMARTS consortium telescopes (such as the CTIO 0.9m and 1.5m telescopes) for long-term stellar and astronomical monitoring.
facility_description: The Small and Moderate Aperture Research Telescope System (SMARTS) operates telescopes at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile.
notes: Filter curves correspond to the Tek 2K CCD and facility filters at the SMARTS 0.9m telescope.
